PURPOSE                                                                                             
Jørgen 2026-11-19 08:55Z: attach a request to a piece of the text in a mark mode, so the AI knows   
exactly what it is about; questions today look like acceptance criteria. 09:05Z (answer 1 on this   
task): threads inside the ticket would bloat it, and the conversation must not become the thing.    
The ticket must stay crisp: clarity comes from boiling text down to its essence. The messy part     
goes to a separate, suitably named history file in the task's files (provenance, chat history)      
that grows by appending.
